Upper Text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Gaogamon] in name or w/[DATA SQUAD] trait: Cost 3

[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the hand. Then, by trashing the bottom face-down card under any of your Tamers, return 1 of your opponent's lowest level Digimon to the hand.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects add cards to your opponent's hand or trash cards from under your Tamers, this Digimon may unsuspend.
